topic: Dashboards and graphs show times in the wrong timezone
symptom_pattern: A user says all graph timestamps are hours off compared to their local time, while a colleague sees the correct times on the same dashboard.
root_cause: The user's profile timezone preference is set to a different timezone (e.g. UTC) instead of browser default.
resolution_path: Ask for a screenshot of the time axis and their local time
Check the user's Preferences timezone setting
Set it to browser default or the desired zone

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is the colleague in the same timezone as you?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, we're in the same office.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you check Personal Settings > Preferences > Time zone?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: It says UTC. I don't remember setting that.
